speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit if you are eating. You are not eating. Then do not stand in the door like a man waiting to be asked twice. Six was said at noon. This is six.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: There is a heel if you want it in the hand, sir. I am not laying it on a plate. A plate is a place, and you have none tonight.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep the heel for the morning. I am not making a supper out of a crust in a doorway. I will be late. No one is to sit up.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then go when you go. I have the spoons, and I am using them. The street is your business. This fire is mine for the next hour, and it is not a consultation.
